Madhya Pradesh MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025

Post Date: March 7, 2025

11:47 am

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission MPPSC, has been released notification on the official website for the recruitment of Assistant Professor. This recruitment is for 1,930 positions. The MPPSC application process started on February 27, 2025, and candidates can apply until March 26, 2025. The minimum age required is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years as on January 1, 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025.
